subject: Scheduling: executive demo across US / EU / APAC — availability & DST note
messages:
From: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>
Date: 2027-06-14T09:02:00-04:00
Subject: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

Hi Rafael / Monica,

Thanks again for the last sync — our execs are keen to see a single, joint demo that brings Redwood’s routing/fallback + Dedicated options to life. We need three execs to attend: CTO (US), Head of Ops (EU), CTO APAC (SG/Tokyo).

Goal: 40-minute exec walkthrough with Q&A + a 10-minute architecture follow-up.
Constraints we have:
- US CTO only has morning windows (8:00–10:30 PT) on weekdays.
- EU Head of Ops prefers 15:00–17:30 CEST.
- APAC CTO can join in their morning (09:00–11:00 JST / SGT) or late evening UTC windows.

Can you share possible overlapping windows the week of July 12–16 (our preferred weeks)? Also, can you flag any daylight savings pitfalls we should be aware of for cross-quarter scheduling (we might want a reproducible playbook if we do this as a series)?

Thanks — cc'ing Amit (partner) and Kenji (APAC lead) who will help coordinate logistics on our side.

Regards,
Claire
Director, Strategic Accounts
Nectar Inc.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>, Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-15T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

Claire — thanks for the clear constraints. Good to loop Monica (SE lead) here.

Quick read: there are a few 30–60 minute overlap pockets between US morning / EU late afternoon / APAC morning, but they’re tight. Two options that usually work:
- Option A (single overlap): 09:00 PT / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 SGT (next day) — late for APAC CTO, likely not ideal.
- Option B (staggered exec handoff): 08:30 PT (US CTO joins for first 20m) -> 16:30 CEST (EU joins for middle) -> 09:30 SGT next day (APAC-focused deep-dive with recorded handoff).

Monica — can you attach an availability grid with your SE and exec availability? If we go staggered we’ll want an explicit handoff script and a short pre-brief with each exec so there’s no duplication.

On DST: the timing differences you flagged matter most for recurring series across Q3->Q4. Practically: EU/UK DST ends Oct 31 this year and US ends Nov 7 — two separate cutovers. If you plan follow-ups into late Q4, we should publish times in UTC and include a simple DST change note in the invite so calendar clients don’t auto-shift attendees unexpectedly. I’ll draft a brief playbook once we lock a window.

Proposed next step: Monica + I will consolidate 4 candidate windows by EOD tomorrow; Claire/Amit/Kenji pick the preferred slot and we publish a single calendar invite with run-of-show and recordings enabled.

—Rafael
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>, Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-16T08:27:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

Adding availability grid (attached). Highlights:
- July 13 & 15: best chance for single-window overlap between US early morning and EU late afternoon (we show 08:30 PT / 17:30 CEST).
- July 14: APAC-friendly morning but US CTO can't do earlier than 08:00 PT.

Attachments: availability-grid-nectar-202706.csv (CSV with 15-minute granular constraints for each exec)

Operational notes:
- If we pick a single 40-min window, recommend: 20m demo (product + high-level architecture), 15m customer Q&A, 5m handoff note for APAC follow-up.
- For late APAC times we will bring an on-call SE to run the demo and the US exec can pre-record a 6-minute CTO intro that Monica will play live to save time.

Aditya — can you flag whether we can guarantee recorded session access (S3 signed link) and whether recording triggers any compliance review with the Nectar SOC team (Claire, any constraints on where recordings land)?

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>, Kenji Yamamoto <kenji@hajime.co.jp>
Date: 2027-06-17T15:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

Thanks Monica — the grid is helpful. Quick clarifications:
- Our APAC CTO (Kenji) strongly prefers morning JST/SGT (09:00–11:00), which would make a single-window meeting pretty tough.
- If we must choose a single meeting, July 15 17:30 CEST / 08:30 PT would be my team's first choice, but we worry Kenji’s participation will drop.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood propose a two-part cadence (one joint exec show-and-tell + a short APAC deep-dive within 48 hours) so Kenji gets a focused session?
2) Please confirm the recording and where it lives — our legal team needs it stored in EU or US (not in an APAC silo).

If you can draft the 2-part cadence and runbook, we can confirm ASAP.

Best,
Claire
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T06:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

Claire — we can do the two-part cadence. Quick notes on the recording and runbook:
- Recordings: we will host the exec recording in AWS S3 with region selection at the time of upload. For this engagement we can keep the recording in us-east-1 or eu-west-1 — please confirm which region Nectar prefers and we will apply the right S3 bucket (and ACL/KMS).
- Runbook: attached a short draft runbook that covers: pre-brief checklist, handoff script, recording release note, substitute SE coverage for late hours, and RSVP policy for exec attendees.

Attachments: redwood-demo-runbook.pdf

Operational suggestion:
- Host a single joint 40-minute exec session on July 15 17:30 CEST / 08:30 PT.
- Schedule a 30-minute APAC deep-dive on July 16 09:30 SGT with recorded intro + shortened live CTO QA. Redwood will provide an on-call SE for both.

Neha — can you take the calendar invite after Rafael confirms final attendees and publish invites with explicit UTC times and a DST note in the description?

—Aditya
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dubois <claire@nectar.so>, Amit Shah <amit@skysail.ai>, Kenji Yamamoto <kenji@hajime.co.jp>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-25T17:18:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Exec demo request — multi-region availability

All — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming plan and invites:

1) Joint exec session (40m): July 15, 2027 — 17:30 CEST / 08:30 PT / 00:30 SGT (next day). We will run the nominal flow live.
2) APAC deep-dive (30m): July 16, 2027 — 09:30 SGT / 02:30 CEST / 17:30 PT (previous day) — this is intended as a short, focused session for Kenji and APAC engineering.

Notes and asks before invites go out:
- Claire: please confirm whether Nectar prefers the recording stored in eu-west-1 or us-east-1. We’ll configure the S3 bucket and update the invite with the retention policy.
- Kenji: if the APAC deep-dive time (09:30 SGT) is OK, we’ll keep it; otherwise we can rotate it earlier by 30 minutes and Redwood will provide an SE to stand in for the live CTO intro.
- Monica: I attached the calendar invite (.ics) and the runbook link; Aditya — thanks for the runbook draft.

Attachments: calendar-invite-exec-demo.ics, redwood-demo-runbook.pdf

If I don’t hear objections by EOD tomorrow I’ll publish invites and the HubSpot schedule entry.

Best,
Rafael
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
